message: Hey John, hope you're having a good day! What are you up to? 😊
Great job at the game, John! The team is looking stronger than ever.
I miss our times together, John. It's hard seeing you move on. Remember when we watched the sunset at Seaview Park? I still keep the shell necklace we found there.
Celebration at my place tonight? Let's make it happen, coach!
Remember our trip to the beach? I found some old photos of us building that huge sandcastle and the picnic we had after. It brought back memories.
Can't wait to see you later! 😘
The team is pumped for the next match, we won't let you down!
Hey John, are we still on for the training session tomorrow?
You were always the one who understood me. Do you ever think about us? I sometimes recall that cozy winter evening we spent by the fireplace at my old apartment on Pine Street.
I love how passionate you are about your job. It's really inspiring!
